answer: Sybil resistance follows from exponentially decaying reputation: with half-life h, a score contribution halves every h time units, so durable influence requires sustained honest service. In EigenTrust, a freshly spawned identity has few trusted incoming paths and near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, leaving it below consensus thresholds. An oasis of colluding accounts cannot turn a thin thread of interactions into a relic of established credibility.
